en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Washa, from Jameel Bin Darraj and Muhammad Bin Humran, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘They do not inherit (each other), the free and the slave’.
en.sarwar: 1. Al-Husayn from Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla’ ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Afi af-Washsha’ from Jamif ibn Darraj and Muhammad ibn Humran who has narrated the foiiowing: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
The free and slaves do not inherit each other.’”
